text:
mike: heads up — midnight change window still on, final readiness check. Can everyone confirm pins + release notes are in place?

sara: release notes posted: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21. TL;DR: v3.4.1 small latency opt + dedupe cache fix.

jen: build pinned to `v3.4.1-20260321` in deploy-bot. No hotfix exceptions open. :white_check_mark:

alex: infra smoke passed in staging. CPU and mem within baseline. latency p95 180ms.

sam: tagging canary owners: sam (oncall), jen (runtime), alex (infra). Rollback owner if canary fails = jen.

mike: ok. Freeze reminder: no schema or prod-migrations during window. Exceptions must go through me + @sara.

ops-bot: NOTE: Quiet window starts at 00:00 UTC. Alerts will be escalated to #eng-oncall after 00:10 if error rate > 1%.

deploy-bot: starting canary rollout to 2% traffic on prod-us at 4477001236. canary_id=cn-4477.

sam: watching metrics. set manual hold if error-rate > 2% or latency p95 > 300ms.

deploy-bot: canary metrics @ 4477001239 — error_rate=0.9%, p95=190ms, throughput=120rps.

jen: running automated evals against smoke prompt set — no regressions so far.

mike: thanks. keep me posted at the 5m cadence or ping if anything looks off.

deploy-bot: canary metrics @ 4477001245 — error_rate=3.8%, spike in 10m window, error samples show `kv-cache` OOM on a subset of shards.

sam: hold the rollout. triggering rollback checklist. :rotating_light:

jen: confirming, pausing deploybot traffic. `deploy-bot pause cn-4477` — done.

mike: good call. rollback plan: roll back canary to previous model variant v3.3.9-canary. jen you own rollback exec; sam you own alert triage.

jen: executing rollback: `deploy rollback --canary cn-4477 --to v3.3.9-canary --reason "kv-cache OOMs on canary"`

deploy-bot: rollback started at 4477001249. estimated completion 60s.

ops-bot: incident note created: INC-20260321-4477. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260321-4477

alex: infra teams checking node-level OOM signals. provisioning extra swap on the affected shards while we stabilize.

mike: after rollback completes, we do a post-mortem and mark freeze-exemption if we need a patch. For now we keep quiet window until 02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 4477001250. canary traffic back to v3.3.9-canary.

sam: monitoring — error_rate back to baseline, p95 185ms.

mike: great. thanks all — short retro tomorrow AM. If any teams need to request a hotfix exemption, open PR and tag me + sara. :thumbsup:
